name: Brill Town Hall
summary: Brill Town Hall anchors Forsaken rule in the shattered heart of Lordaeron. From its doors, the undead govern Brill and coordinate the defense of Tirisfal Glades.

sections.title: Civic Seat of the Forsaken
sections.body: Brill Town Hall remains open under Forsaken rule while much of Lordaeron lies in ruins. Magistrate Sevren directs town affairs from his podium, issuing orders to Forsaken travelers. Beyond the Defiler's Den in the Arathi Highlands, few recognized town halls in the known world remain active under Forsaken control. Brill’s hall carries on Lordaeron’s old civic order beneath undead rule.

faq.q: What is the Brill Town Hall used for?
faq.answer: Brill Town Hall is the local seat of government for Brill. Magistrate Sevren and other Forsaken leaders use it to direct local defense, issue decrees, and assign work to travelers and newly awakened undead.
Magistrate Sevren presides over Brill Town Hall from his podium. He manages town affairs for the Forsaken and directs their operations across central Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: Why is this town hall notable compared to others?
aliases: are there other forsaken town halls
faq.answer: Brill Town Hall is one of the few active civic halls run by the Forsaken. The Defiler's Den in Arathi is another, while most town halls belong to living human kingdoms.

angles.text: As a Forsaken setting out from Deathknell, you find your first taste of organized civic rule under Queen Sylvanas here. Local defense and efforts to reclaim the land are formally arranged within Brill Town Hall.
As a Horde ally arriving in Tirisfal, you can visit Brill Town Hall to see how the Forsaken maintain civil authority and military order in their darkened homeland.
